_howToEdit: PRIMARY INPUT: each character's `stats` block, copied off the in-game stats page.
atk + atkBase, hp + hpBase, def + defBase, critRate, critDmg, energyRegen,
elemDmg (the element line as shown), and the per-type DMG bonuses.
The *Base fields are the WHITE numbers. An ATK% buff multiplies those, not the total.
Update these after any gear change and you are done — nothing else needs touching.
`level` and `talents` are still required, and are also read, not inferred: level drives
enemy-DEF scaling and the negative-status coefficient, talents pick the ability multiplier.
Everything below the stats block — baseScale, weapon overrides, forteNodes, echoes — is a
RECONSTRUCTION kept for echo-swap experiments and as a cross-check. It is NOT used for
damage while `stats` is present. See claude/wuwa-weapon-and-forte-curves.md.
Buffs live on whoever provides them. target:'team' reaches everyone, target:'self' only the owner.
panel:true means the buff is ALREADY inside the stats block and is skipped, to avoid
double-counting. default:true means rotations normally switch it on.
Stat keys: hp flatAtk def hpPct atkPct defPct critRate critDmg energyRegen healingBonus
basicDmg heavyDmg skillDmg libDmg introDmg outroDmg echoDmg attrDmg elemDmg:<element>

augusta._reconciled: Solved 2026-08-12. She is Lv70 POST-ascension (scale 1.0, agreeing from DEF and HP independently). Her Crit Rate residual of exactly +10.0 is Thunderflare Dominion's substat at Lv70, not forte nodes: 10.0/12.1 = 0.826, matching the weapon substat curve measured independently on Everbright Polestar, Variation and Firstlight's Herald. Her four ATK nodes ARE unlocked; her four Crit Rate nodes are not. That is what makes her weapon's base-ATK ratio (0.756) land in the same band as Aemeath (0.766), Verina (0.752) and Suisui (0.738) instead of being a lone outlier at 0.846.
